A power grid is a balancing act.
Every second, the electricity going in has to match the electricity going out.
title: cards
subtitle: EVERY SECOND::IN=Power made|OUT=Power used|MUST MATCH=Or it trips

narration: If that balance breaks badly enough, parts of the system shut themselves down to stay safe, and one shutdown can trigger the next, and the next.
title: loop
subtitle: THE CHAIN REACTION::ONE LINE FAILS|THE BALANCE BREAKS|PARTS SHUT DOWN|THE NEXT ONE TRIPS

narration: This isn't a theory.
In February 2025, a single high-voltage line failed in northern Chile, and the chain reaction left about ninety percent of the country in the dark.

Because GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time, the launch rolls across the planet one time zone at a time, and midnight is one of the quietest moments on any power grid.

The real blackout risk on launch night is the ordinary kind: a storm, a fault, a damaged cable somewhere.
